correctness.rationale: The published rank theorem reduces the problem to weighted product-one cyclic orbits. The map from the source alphabet to the multiplicative group is uniform, so character sums vanish for every nontrivial character. Möbius inversion gives the exact primitive-word count, character orthogonality extracts product one, division by the least period counts cyclic orbits, and summation over divisors yields the formula. The error bound follows from elementary divisor-size bounds. Independent exact computations match direct small-orbit enumeration, all forty displayed table values, and the published p-power corollary.
